name: login
description: Fixed, deterministic login sequence -- extracted byte-for-byte from run-batch-executions.js's LOGIN_SCRIPT_STEPS after it was proven end to end on real BrowserStack hardware for both Android and iOS (docs/STATUS.md bugs 18-23). Each step is resolved against the live screen by the same per-instruction resolver executeSemanticAction() already uses everywhere else -- only the step ORDER is fixed here, not which selector a step resolves to.

steps.instruction: tap the Allow button to dismiss a system permission dialog
tap the LOGIN button on the home screen to open the login form
type the phone number into the phone/account number field
tap the PASSWORD tab to switch the form into password-entry mode
tap the password field to focus it
type the password into the password field
tap the LOGIN button to submit the login form
